name: bosch-shc-web-ui
description: Local web UI & dashboard for Bosch Smart Home Controller (SHC I/II): history charts, energy costs, device health. No cloud. Home Assistant add-on, Docker, Node.js.

paragraphs: A fast, local web interface and dashboard for the Bosch Smart Home Controller (SHC I and II) — control every device from any browser, see history charts and energy costs, and keep an eye on batteries and signal quality. An open-source alternative to the Bosch Smart Home app for desktop, tablet and wall panels. Runs entirely in your home network, no cloud. Install as a Home Assistant add-on, with Docker or plain Node.js. English and German.

Auf Deutsch: Lokale Weboberfläche für den Bosch Smart Home Controller – alle Geräte im Browser steuern, Verlaufsdiagramme für Temperatur und Luftfeuchtigkeit, Stromverbrauch und -kosten, Batterie- und Funkstatus. Ohne Cloud, als Home-Assistant-Add-on, Docker-Container oder mit Node.js. Die Oberfläche gibt es komplett auf Deutsch.
features: Dashboard — all devices by room: heating, shutters, lights, plugs, contacts, smoke and motion detectors, Twinguard, cameras. Live updates without reloading.
History charts — temperature, humidity, power, valve position, air quality and more, from 24 hours to a year. Includes values the Bosch app doesn't show.
Energy — consumption and cost per day, week, month and year, per device, with your own electricity price.
Health — unreachable devices, low batteries, weak signal and pending firmware updates at a glance.
Favourites & kiosk mode — a clean wall-tablet view with just the devices and scenarios you need.

requirements.text: Install as an app on phone or desktop (PWA), optional login with multiple users, light and dark theme.
Optional login, switched on or off under Admin → Login at any time: admin creates users, resets passwords, sees and revokes sessions.
